name: Folding metal sun lounger
material: 2*1 tesilin fabrics w/t steel frame powder coated
description:
Relax in Style with Our Comfortable and Durable Striped Deck Chair
Bring a touch of timeless summer style to your garden, patio, or balcony with the Striped Outdoor Folding Deck Chair with Durable Textilene Fabric and Iron Frame. Designed for both comfort and practicality, this lightweight yet strong deck chair is crafted from a robust iron frame and breathable, weather-resistant Textilene fabric. Whether you are soaking up the sun or enjoying a quiet evening outdoors, this deck chair offers stylish support and easy storage with its foldable design.
